findings.description:
**Synopsis**: This plugin displays information about the Nessus scan.

This plugin displays, for each tested host, information about the scan itself.
findings.impact: This plugin displays information about the Nessus scan.
findings.title: Nessus Scan Information

findings.description:
**Synopsis**: A DNS server is listening on the remote host.

The remote service is a Domain Name System (DNS) server.
findings.impact: A DNS server is listening on the remote host.
findings.mitigations: Disable this service if it is not needed.
findings.title: DNS Server Detection

findings.description:
**Synopsis**: Signing is not required on the remote SMB server.

Signing is not required on the remote SMB server. An unauthenticated, remote attacker can exploit this to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks against the SMB server.
findings.impact: Signing is not required on the remote SMB server.
findings.mitigations: Enforce message signing in the host's configuration.
findings.title: SMB Signing not required

findings.description:
**Synopsis**: The remote Windows host is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.

The remote Windows host is affected by multiple remote code execution vulnerabilities in SMBv1.
findings.impact: The remote Windows host is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
findings.title: MS17-010: Security Update for Microsoft Windows SMB Server (ETERNALBLUE)

findings.description:
**Synopsis**: The remote web server is not enforcing HSTS.

The remote web server is not enforcing HSTS.
findings.impact: The remote web server is not enforcing HSTS.
findings.mitigations: Configure the remote web server to use HSTS.
findings.title: HSTS Missing From HTTPS Server (RFC 6797)
